translations.web: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
translations.bsb: In the third month, on the same day of the month that the Israelites had left the land of Egypt, they came to the Wilderness of Sinai.
translations.kjv: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
